# Progress bar: purple (p) at cols 0-45 (46 pixels), white (W) at cols 46-63 (18 pixels)
# Goal: Fill the purple bar completely (64 pixels)
# Current progress: 46/64 = 72%

# Let me continue the cycle: ACTION7, collect green blocks, repeat.
# I'll batch actions to be more efficient.

# First, use ACTION7
result = action(['ACTION7'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
green_blocks = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"After ACTION7: {len(green_blocks)} green blocks")

# Get player position
player_b = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b']
p_min_c = min(x[1] for x in player_b[0]['boundary'])
p_max_c = max(x[1] for x in player_b[0]['boundary'])
p_center = (p_min_c + p_max_c) // 2
print(f"Player: cols {p_min_c}-{p_max_c}, center={p_center}")

# Get green block positions
for g in green_blocks:
    b = g['boundary']
    min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
    max_c = max(p[1] for p in b)
    center_c = (min_c + max_c) // 2
    min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
    max_r = max(p[0] for p in b)
    center_r = (min_r + max_r) // 2
    print(f"  Green at cols {min_c}-{max_c}, center={center_c}, rows {min_r}-{max_r}")

# Collect all green blocks
actions = []
for g in green_blocks:
    b = g['boundary']
    min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
    max_c = max(p[1] for p in b)
    center_c = (min_c + max_c) // 2
    min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
    max_r = max(p[0] for p in b)
    center_r = (min_r + max_r) // 2
    
    # Calculate moves to align player with green block
    diff = center_c - p_center
    if diff > 0:
        moves_needed = (diff + 4) // 5  # Round up, player moves 5 cols per RIGHT
        actions.extend(['RIGHT'] * moves_needed)
        p_center += moves_needed * 5
    elif diff < 0:
        moves_needed = ((-diff) + 4) // 5
        actions.extend(['LEFT'] * moves_needed)
        p_center -= moves_needed * 5
    
    # Click on green block
    actions.append({'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c})

print(f"\nActions to execute: {len(actions)}")
if actions:
    result = action(actions)
    
    # Check result
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    green_blocks = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
    print(f"After collecting: {len(green_blocks)} green blocks")
    
    # Check progress bar
    p_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'p']
    w_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'W']
    p_pixels = p_nodes[0]['pixels'] if p_nodes else 0
    w_pixels = w_nodes[0]['pixels'] if w_nodes else 0
    print(f"Progress bar: purple={p_pixels}, white={w_pixels}, total={p_pixels+w_pixels}")
    
    # Check blue passage
    S_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'S']
    blue_pixels = S_nodes[0]['pixels'] if S_nodes else 0
    print(f"Blue pixels: {blue_pixels}")
    
    print(f"Level completed: {result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
